captions.text: Job hunting is a full-time job.
Job Explorer takes the sorting off your plate.
It searches the job boards you choose, and AI scores every posting against your own experience.
Strong matches rise to the top.
Weak ones sink, so you spend your time on jobs worth applying for.
Open any job to see exactly why it fits, and where the gaps are.
Apply on the employer's site, then mark it applied.
The tracker keeps every application and where it stands, all in one place.
And stats show what's working, from response rates to interviews.
Your data stays encrypted on your computer.
Use local AI, and nothing leaves it at all.
Get it today on the Microsoft Store.
